projectDescription: A Flask + FastAPI web platform that serves as an AI-powered guide for a museum's Birds Hall, combining QR code scanning, RAG-enhanced chatbot conversations, and text-to-speech narration to give visitors interactive species information.
keyFeatures: QR code scanning to identify and display bird species information
RAG-powered chatbot using Ollama LLM + ChromaDB vector store for context-aware answers
Text-to-speech narration via Microsoft Edge TTS (es-CO-GonzaloNeural voice by default)
Admin CRUD panel for species, museum documents, and QR style customization
Scan metrics dashboard with daily/origin charts and species ranking
Species comparison with LLM-generated analysis for taxonomically related birds
Per-user visit tracking and personalized tour memory in chat context
Docker Compose stack with ngrok tunnels for public HTTPS access on low-power hardware (Orange Pi 4 Pro)
Customizable QR code styles (frames, colors, module shapes)
Species audit log tracking all admin create/update/delete/view actions
publicApiSurface: POST /api/chat — non-streaming RAG chat (anonymous or authenticated)
POST /api/chat_stream — streaming RAG chat (authenticated users)
GET /api/especies/comparar/analysis — LLM-powered species comparison JSON
GET /api/admin/metricas — scan metrics JSON (admin only)
GET /api/admin/especies/auditoria — species audit log JSON (admin only)
GET /scan/<qr_id> — QR scan entry point, records scan event, redirects to species page
GET /especie/<qr_id> — public species detail page
GET /especies — public species listing with search
GET /especies/comparar — species comparison page
POST /internal/species/sync — TTS service: pre-generate audio for a species (shared key required)
POST /internal/species/delete — TTS service: remove audio cache for a species (shared key required)
GET /tts/by-qr/{qr_id} — TTS service: serve pre-generated MP3 by QR ID (API key required)
POST /qr/resolve-frame — TTS service: detect QR from JPEG frame and return audio info (API key required)
POST /tts/from-text — TTS service: generate ad-hoc MP3 from arbitrary text (API key required)
POST /tts/from-frame — TTS service: detect QR from JPEG and stream matching pre-generated audio (API key required)
WS /ws/qr-stream — TTS service: WebSocket stream for real-time QR detection and text delivery
GET /health — TTS service health check
flask init-db — initialize SQLite database
flask create-admin — create admin user from env vars
flask create-user — create regular user from env vars
flask seed — insert Cóndor Andino sample species
flask reindex-all — reindex all species into ChromaDB vector store
